title: RequireOnRails project settings
description: Project-level settings for RequireOnRails (requireonrails.json). Keys set here win over .vscode/settings.json; unset keys fall back to it, then to the shipped defaults.

mode.description: How requires are resolved. 'dynamic' generates basename aliases resolved at runtime; 'explicit' writes full, statically-resolvable paths into your source at edit time.

explicitPathStyle.description: Explicit mode only: the form written when RequireOnRails completes or rewrites a require path.

preferRelativePaths.description: Explicit mode only: when the relative form of a path has strictly fewer segments than the configured explicitPathStyle form, write the relative form instead.

rojoProjectPath.description: Explicit mode only: workspace-relative path of the Rojo project file used to map files to DataModel paths for the 'game' path style. Only used when no sourcemap is found at sourcemapPath. Glob $path values and globIgnorePaths are not supported.

sourcemapPath.description: Explicit mode only: workspace-relative path of a Rojo-generated sourcemap, the preferred source for mapping files to DataModel paths for the 'game' path style. Falls back to rojoProjectPath when the file is missing. Keep 'rojo sourcemap --watch' running so newly created files stay resolvable.

enableAbsolutePathUpdates.description: Whether to prompt for updating absolute require paths when files are moved between different alias directories.

enableFileNameCollisionResolution.description: Whether to detect and handle filename collisions by automatically renaming files with '_Duplicate' suffix.

enableBasenameUpdates.description: Whether to prompt for updating basename require statements when files are renamed.

importModulePaths.description: The valid values for the `require` override. This is used to generate the contextual import statements. Uses the first value in the array as the default import path if one is not found.

contextualImportTemplate.description: Template used when inserting contextual import code. Must include {IMPORT_MODULE_PATH} placeholder.

preferredImportPlacement.description: Controls where the import require definition is placed when automatically added to files

directoriesToScan.description: Directories to scan for generating Luau file aliases. Relative to the workspace root.

ignoreDirectories.description: Regex patterns for directories/files to ignore when scanning for Luau files to generate aliases. By default uses '^_.*' to ignore anything prefixed with an underscore.

manualAliases.description: Manual aliases for absolute path support. Maps alias names to their corresponding directory paths (relative to workspace root).

pathPriority.description: Ordered path prefixes used to resolve ambiguous auto-generated aliases. Earlier entries are higher priority. An ambiguous basename is resolved only when exactly one candidate matches the highest-priority matched prefix; if multiple candidates match that same highest-priority prefix, it remains ambiguous.

onAliasesRegenerated.description: Shell commands to run after aliases are regenerated. Each command is executed from the workspace root. Only commands set in your own User settings are ever run; if a workspace sets this, RequireOnRails ignores the commands and notifies you so you can review them and opt in.

enabled.description: Enable Build conversion: produce a runtime-module-free copy of the project by rewriting alias requires to natively-resolvable forms at build time. Enables the build commands and stops Import boilerplate insertion — the RequireOnRails Luau module is no longer needed.

outputDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory the Build Project command writes the converted copy of the scanned directories into. Consumed by rojo via the generated build project file. Recommended for .gitignore.

outputRequireStyle.description: The require form Build conversion writes into the converted output.

buildProjectFile.description: Workspace-relative path the Generate Build Project File command writes the build Rojo project to (the user's project file with $path entries redirected into the output directory).

onBuildCompleted.description: Shell commands to run after a successful Build Project run, e.g. a darklua or stylua pass over the output directory. Executed from the workspace root with ROR_EVENT, ROR_OUTPUT_DIR and ROR_BUILD_PROJECT environment variables. Workspace-supplied commands need one-time approval, same as onAliasesRegenerated.

onWatchConverted.description: Shell commands to run after each watch conversion batch, with ROR_EVENT, ROR_OUTPUT_DIR and ROR_CHANGED_FILES (newline-separated) environment variables. Empty by default so nothing external runs in the watch hot path. Workspace-supplied commands need one-time approval, same as onAliasesRegenerated.
